prior_finding.title: Generic soy owner still asserts branded product and alternative aliases
prior_finding.observation: The selected generic Soy_Peptone payload changes primary identity to kgmicrobe.ingredient:soy_peptone but retains EXACT_SYNONYM Phytone peptone and Soytone, CATALOG_VARIANT Phytone peptone (BD-BBL), Bacto Soytone, and the complete Soytone-or-Phytone alternative. The same active batch creates a distinct Difco Soytone owner and assigns Phytone its own identity. The manufacturer guide describes different soy product processing. The generic owner notes expressly postpone branded alias reconciliation. This is an unresolved contradiction in the complete proposed owner, not a claim that the narrow identifier correction caused the inherited aliases.
prior_finding.bounded_required_followup: Prepare a successor that preserves the exact unsupported branded/alternative strings, original source and history as nonresolving provenance. Do not infer a forced record merge, catalog equivalence, occurrence reassignment or count redistribution. Treat the active Soya_Pepton/Soya_Peptone family and W08 competing proposal as dependencies requiring separate source-aware reconciliation.

prior_finding.title: Fish-sperm DNA owner retains generic and conflicting tissue aliases
prior_finding.observation: The complete selected Fish-Sperm DNA owner keeps ten EXACT_SYNONYM entries copied from generic DNA, including DNA, deoxyribonucleic acids and thymus nucleic acid. Its primary identity is the narrower fish-sperm material and its ontology relation to CHEBI16991 is NARROW_MATCH. The four inspected source recipes explicitly name fish-sperm DNA (SERVA), without a species or thymus claim. Supplier-form enrichment preserves this existing unsafe alias scope.
prior_finding.bounded_required_followup: Retype unsupported generic or conflicting-tissue identity aliases as nonresolving provenance, preserving strings, sources and history. Retain the source-specific SERVA fact; do not infer species, molecular length or counterion, and do not reverse the herring-sperm tombstone solely from this finding.

prior_finding.title: Bacto owner retains a fish-product alias despite the mammalian product boundary
prior_finding.observation: The final Bacto_Peptone payload preserves CATALOG_VARIANT Fish peptone (Fluka), while the same owner already rejects Fish peptone. The inspected Bacto supplier specification defines bovine/porcine digest, and MICRO0000178 is mammalian protein digest. The fish-specific Fluka label is not supported as an identity of that product. Additional remaining generic meat/mixture aliases require individual assessment, but this finding requires no guessed replacement for them.
prior_finding.bounded_required_followup: Retire the literal Fish peptone (Fluka) resolving identity claim as nonresolving provenance while preserving its exact text/source/history. Do not infer a Fluka catalog, redirect counts or treat brand difference alone as chemical distinctness. Other ambiguous aliases require their own evidence; this finding does not decide them.

prior_finding.title: Optional typed sucrose component link is available
prior_finding.observation: The 20% w/v sucrose stock appropriately remains PARTIAL because its solvent is not explicitly supplied. The same active review includes the extant Sucrose owner CHEBI17992 and an official sucrose term capture; its d-salicin alias repair does not change sucrose identity. No scientific reason is stated for withholding this known typed component link. Section 6 explicitly permits UNMAPPED named components. This is not a schema failure or a false identity claim; the decision does not explicitly assert that no sucrose owner exists.
